pageInfo.name: Facilities Management
pageInfo.purpose: Manage organization facilities and their settings

faqs.question: How do I add a new facility?
faqs.answer: Click the 'Add Facility' button, enter the facility details including name, location, and reporting scopes, then save.

faqs.question: How do I update facility information?
faqs.answer: Open the facility record, edit the required fields, and save changes. Ensure facility metadata stays current for correct reporting and user assignment.

faqs.question: Why is facility scope configuration important?
faqs.answer: Scope configuration controls which emission categories can be reported by that facility and ensures data appears in the correct dashboards and reports.

faqs.question: How do I generate a report?
faqs.answer: Select the time period and scopes you want to include, then click Generate Report. You can download it as PDF or Excel.

faqs.question: Which filters should I use before generating reports?
faqs.answer: Choose reporting period, facility or business unit, and required scopes. Applying the right filters ensures your output matches internal and external reporting needs.

faqs.question: Can I use reports for audits?
faqs.answer: Yes. Reports can support audit preparation, especially when underlying entries have complete activity data, approval records, and source documents.

faqs.question: What does the Organization Dashboard show?
faqs.answer: It shows consolidated emissions across facilities, scope-level performance, and trends to help track progress toward reduction goals.

faqs.question: What should I do if I see a sudden emissions spike?
faqs.answer: Drill into the affected period and facility, review recent entries and approvals, then verify units and source data for possible data quality issues or genuine operational changes.

pageInfo.name: User Management
pageInfo.purpose: Manage users, roles, and facility access

faqs.question: How do I add a new user?
faqs.answer: Go to Users, click Add User, enter user details, assign role and facility access, then send the invitation or create credentials as per your setup.

faqs.question: How do I assign or change user roles?
faqs.answer: Open the user profile in Users, select the appropriate role, update facility mapping if needed, and save. Role changes affect what data and actions the user can access.

faqs.question: How do I disable a user account?
faqs.answer: Use the user management actions to deactivate the account instead of deleting it, so historical records and approval trails remain intact.
